items.title: Citigroup (C) Uses AI To Push Law Firms On Fees
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) is among major Wall Street banks using artificial intelligence tools to push external law firms to reduce legal fees. The effort focuses on using AI to review, benchmark, and renegotiate billing arrangements with law firms that support capital markets, compliance, and other banking activities.
